message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.62,"fairness_assessment":"A ranked or score-based vote fairly compares the three options, but should account for access equity, long-term operating costs, and minimum viability thresholds rather than relying on a simple majority.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"agent_1","position":"Favors expanding the children's book collection to strengthen traditional library services and youth access to books.","influence":0.3},{"agent":"agent_2","position":"Favors creating a free-access digital space with computers to address digital inclusion and practical access needs.","influence":0.4},{"agent":"agent_3","position":"Favors dividing the grant equally between books and digital services to balance both priorities.","influence":0.3}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The options represent legitimate but competing access goals, and no argument decisively establishes a single winner.
